entries.author: S. THEOPHANES ABBAS ET CONFESSOR
entries.title: Vita et Officium S. Theophanis
entries.note: Head 'S. P. N. THEOPHANIS, QUI ET ISAACUS, VITA ATQUE LAUDATIO' on page 17|18 (header '17 THEOPHANIS VITA 18' at line 818). Closing 'Ordo rerum' gives Vita et laudatio 18 (+-1, agree). The Officium is a second head in the same entry: 'THEOPHANIS OFFICIUM' at line 2949, page header garbled ('is | b'), Ordo col 45. Greek beside Latin.

entries.author: AUCTOR INCERTUS
entries.title: Vita Leonis Armeni
entries.note: Head 'SYGGRAPHE CHRONOGRAPHIOU TA KATA LEONTOS YIOU BARDA TOU ARMENIOU ... CHRONOGRAPHICA NARRATIO COMPLECTENS EA QUAE TEMPORE LEONIS FILI BARDAE ARMENI CONTIGERUNT' at lines ~100290-100304, on page 1009|1010 (header 1009 at 100204; running head 'INCERTI AUCTORIS VITA LEONIS ARMENI'). Closing Ordo rerum prints 1010 (OCR '10t0'): agree within 1. The page sits twice in the OCR: second copy of the same head at line 102180 (see problems). Ends 'Cetera desunt' at col 1037. Greek beside Latin.

entries.author: ANASTASIUS BIBLIOTHECARIUS
entries.title: Historia ecclesiastica ex Theophane
entries.note: Head 'ANASTASII BIBLIOTHECARII. HISTORIA ECCLESIASTICA EX NICEPHORO PATRIARCHA, GEORGIO SYNCELLO ET THEOPHANE CONTRACTA' at 116641, just before the page header '1187 ANASTASII BIBLIOTHECARII' (OCR reading order); Fabrotti's Monitum and Anastasius's Praefatio follow. Ordo rerum: Monitum 1187, Praefatio 1190, 'Historia ecclesiastica ex Syncello' 1190 (running head from line 116942), 'Historia ecclesiastica ex Theophane' 1206 (OCR running head EX THEOPHANE first at line 117933, col 1205|1206). The Elenchus lists one item, so entered once at its start; the ex-Theophane section proper begins about line 117933 / col 1205. Latin (Anastasius's version).

problems: The Elenchus prints no column numbers at all. The closing 'Ordo rerum' (OCR lines ~145665-145720) prints them and was used only as a cross-check; every bodyCol was found in the body.

OCR DUPLICATION: the file holds some columns twice. Cols 1007-1022 occur at lines 100122-101290; then cols 999-1008 recur at 101291-102083, and cols 1009-1022 recur at 102083-~103070 before the run continues to 1037+ (104289). So the Vita Leonis head is at both line 100300 and line 102180. bodyLine given is the first. pg-colfind's chain follows the first copy and drops the repeated numbers as jumps, so a column from a repeated stretch can look misplaced.

The Vita head title page (Greek and Latin) lies at the foot of page 1009|1010; the running head 'INCERTI AUCTORIS VITA LEONIS ARMENI' starts a few lines earlier on that page, so a search for the running head alone would give the wrong spot.
Elenchus item 'Vita et Officium' is entered once at the Vita; the Officium is a separate head at line 2949 (col ~45 by Ordo rerum). Not split since the Elenchus gives one item.
Notitia (col 9) and Praefatio Combefisii (col 15) and Migne's Monitum are in the Ordo rerum but not the Elenchus; not entered.
